title: JFK's planned US–Soviet alliance against the Nordics

tellings.quote: Was an alliance with the Soviet Union where we would both go to the moon together and if necessary, we would both defend the freedom and independence of humanity

plain: In the 1960s, President John F. Kennedy is said to have planned an alliance with the Soviet Union in which the two countries would go to the moon together and, if needed, jointly "defend the freedom and independence of humanity." The supposed threat was the Nordics, a name in UFO lore for tall, fair, human-looking beings. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells this without naming a source, and he also brings up the president's brother Robert F. Kennedy and the earlier president Dwight Eisenhower. If true, it would mean the Cold War rivals saw a shared enemy that was not human.
